# JSON dependency

nlohmann/json 3.12.0, C++ header-only, MIT. Header tree in `nlohmann/`; license in `LICENSE`.

Vendored from the `nlohmann_json==3.12.0` distribution. Upstream: https://github.com/nlohmann/json . No network downloads occur during CMake configure/build.

This is the only non-STL source dependency. CMake installed for verification is a build tool and is not bundled in this project.
